meta.notes: No image generation tools available in this Claude environment. All prompts are ready for Midjourney v6, DALL-E 3, Flux Pro, or Ideogram v2. Data-viz assets are specified as component blueprints (build in Recharts or as SVG). Client headshot is confirmed and available.

prompts.dimensions: 2047x2048 native, display at 380px wide in 3:4 card
prompts.alt_text: Kristina Bullock, Portland Oregon real estate broker
prompts.approval_notes: Headshot is confirmed and high-res. Verify it renders well in the 3:4 rounded card with object-position: top center. Face should be centered and fully visible. No cropping of chin or forehead.

prompts.model_prompt: Seamless tileable warm linen paper texture, very subtle natural fiber grain visible, cream white color hex FAF7F2, extremely soft and understated, high-resolution macro detail of fine woven fabric or handmade paper, even lighting with no shadows or gradients, barely perceptible texture that adds warmth to a flat background, minimal and refined, no patterns or shapes, no text, 2560x1440 resolution
prompts.negative_prompt: visible repeating pattern, heavy grain, dark spots, wrinkles, creases, colored tints, yellow, blue, obvious texture, distracting, low resolution
prompts.usage_context: Hero section background — tiled or stretched behind headshot and copy. Must not compete with text.
prompts.approval_notes: Should be almost invisible — just adds warmth vs. flat #FAF7F2. If it's noticeable at a glance, it's too strong. Test by placing white text over it — text should be perfectly readable.

prompts.notes: Using Lucide React icons (Home, DollarSign, TrendingUp) at 40x40px, 1.5px stroke, color #C17B5D. Already coded — no generation needed.
prompts.approval_notes: Verify icons render correctly at all breakpoints and maintain consistent size/stroke weight.
Same headshot as hero, displayed smaller in 1:1 square crop. Verify face is well-centered in the square format.

prompts.implementation: Build as a Recharts LineChart component or SVG illustration. NOT an AI-generated image.

chart_spec.y_axis: Label: 'Median Home Value' — NO dollar amounts on axis. Use implied scale.
chart_spec.grid_lines: None — clean minimal style. Subtle x-axis tick marks only.
chart_spec.data_shape: Steep rise 2020-2022, plateau 2023-2024, slight dip 2025, modest uptick into forecast zone 2026
chart_spec.annotation: Small label 'Stabilizing Market' near the 2024-2025 plateau area

prompts.story: Portland home values appreciated rapidly during 2020-2022, stabilized in 2023-2025, and are forecast for modest 2-4% growth. Conveys market maturity and opportunity.
prompts.alt_text: Line chart showing Portland Oregon median home value trend from 2020 to 2026 forecast with stabilizing growth pattern
prompts.approval_notes: This should be built as a React component (Recharts), not generated as an image. No specific dollar amounts — the shape of the line tells the story. Verify the 'Stabilizing Market' annotation doesn't look like a hard claim.

prompts.implementation: Build as a Recharts BarChart component or SVG illustration.

chart_spec.value_labels: None — no percentages or numbers. Visual comparison only.

prompts.story: Portland's rental demand exceeds both state and national averages, making it attractive for buy-and-hold investors.
prompts.alt_text: Horizontal bar chart comparing rental demand in Portland Metro, Oregon, and nationally, showing Portland leading
prompts.approval_notes: Build as component. No specific numbers — the relative bar lengths tell the story. Portland bar should clearly be the longest. Colors match the design profile.

prompts.implementation: Build as a custom React component with CSS/SVG. Horizontal on desktop, vertical on mobile.
